llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了增材制造Ti-6Al-4V点阵超材料的失效机制和强度，直接符合方向对力学性能的要求。
llm.why_not_core: Does not explicitly address fatigue life or cyclic loading; focuses on static strength and failure mechanisms.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V点阵超材料经微观结构改性后的失效机制和强度。
summary_zh.method: 通过拉伸和压缩实验测试不同微观改性的点阵试样。
summary_zh.result: 改性显著影响强度与失效模式。
summary_zh.validation: 机械测试验证实验数据。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the failure mechanisms and strength of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V lattice metamaterials with mesostructural modifications.
summary_en.method: Tensile and compression tests were conducted on Ti-6Al-4V lattice specimens with various mesostructural modifications produced by additive manufacturing.
summary_en.result: Mesostructural modifications significantly influence the strength and failure mechanisms of the lattice metamaterials.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing on fabricated specimens served as validation.

papers.title: Mechanical and Microstructural Characterization of a Titanium-based Ti-6Al-2Cr-2Ni Alloy Produced by SPS Sintering for Use in the Aerospace Industry
papers.abstract: Titanium-based alloys are widely applied in the aerospace industry thanks to their excellent strength-to-weight ratio, good corrosion resistance and thermal stability. In this study, a Ti-6Al-2Cr-2Ni alloy was elaborated by Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS), a technique derived from powder metallurgy that enables rapid, controlled densification. Sintering was carried out at 1000 °C under 30 MPa for 8 minutes in an inert atmosphere. A thermal annealing treatment at 550 °C was then applied to optimize microstructure and mechanical properties. Microstructural characterization by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), combined with EDS elemental analysis, revealed a significant reduction in porosity and progressive homogenization of the alloying elements after treatment. X-ray diffraction (XRD) confirmed the presence of a majority of α-Ti phase, associated with intermetallic compounds. Mechanically, Vickers microhardness measurements showed an increase in hardness after annealing, while instrumented indentation enabled Young's modulus to be reliably determined. These results indicate that the Ti-6Al-2Cr-2Ni alloy developed by SPS is a promising alternative to standard alloys such as Ti-6Al-4V, offering improved microstructural controllability, interesting mechanical properties and thermal optimization potential for advanced aerospace applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti-6Al-2Cr-2Ni合金的SPS烧结及退火处理，而非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的后处理，因此不相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not concern Ti-6Al-4V nor additive manufacturing; it focuses on a different Ti alloy (Ti-6Al-2Cr-2Ni) produced by SPS sintering, not AM.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索SPS烧结Ti-6Al-2Cr-2Ni合金的微观结构和力学性能
summary_zh.method: 通过SPS在1000°C/30MPa下烧结8分钟，随后550°C退火处理
summary_zh.result: 退火后孔隙率降低，硬度增加，杨氏模量可靠测定
summary_zh.validation: SEM、EDS、XRD及显微硬度、压痕实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a titanium-based Ti-6Al-2Cr-2Ni alloy via SPS sintering with improved microstructural control and mechanical properties for aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: The alloy was sintered at 1000°C under 30 MPa for 8 minutes using SPS, followed by a thermal annealing treatment at 550°C.
summary_en.result: Annealing reduced porosity, increased Vickers microhardness, and allowed reliable determination of Young's modulus via instrumented indentation.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization by SEM, EDS, and XRD combined with mechanical testing (microhardness, indentation).

papers.title: Enhanced Interdiffusion and Multilayer Formation at Ti-6Al-4V/Ni Coating Interface Induced by Laser Shock Peening and Vacuum Heat Treatment
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Engineering, Chongqing University, Chongqing, 400045, China

corresponding_authors.name: Cheng Gu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Materials Science and Engineering, Chongqing University, Chongqing, 400045, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光冲击喷丸和真空热处理对Ti-6Al-4V/Ni涂层界面扩散的影响，但未涉及任何力学性能测试，因此对关注后处理对力学性能影响的直接需求帮助有限。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing (fatigue, tensile) of the post-processed Ti-6Al-4V; focus is on interfacial diffusion and coating adhesion rather than mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究激光冲击喷丸和真空热处理对Ti-6Al-4V/Ni涂层界面互扩散的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对镀Ni的Ti-6Al-4V试样进行激光冲击喷丸和真空热处理，利用SEM/EDS表征界面微观结构。
summary_zh.result: 联合处理促进了界面互扩散，形成多层结构。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验表征验证了界面微观结构的演变。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser shock peening and vacuum heat treatment on interdiffusion at the Ti-6Al-4V/Ni coating interface.
summary_en.method: Ni-coated Ti-6Al-4V samples were subjected to LSP and VHT, and the interface microstructure was characterized by SEM/EDS.
summary_en.result: The combined treatment enhanced interfacial interdiffusion and formed a multilayer structure.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization confirmed the evolution of interface microstructure.
